summary.text: Luke Jensen is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 96, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.
Jensen advanced unopposed from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary with 1,001 votes and faces Republican Kerryl Clement.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia's profile of Jensen lists earlier campaigns for the Maine House, including a 2014 general election loss as the Republican nominee to incumbent Democrat Michel Lajoie, 1,818 votes (42.8 percent) to 2,230 (52.5 percent).
It also lists a 2018 run in District 61 as an independent, in which he received 151 votes (5.7 percent) and incumbent Democrat Heidi Brooks won.
